# shared

```go
import "github.com/lucasavila00/tgo/internal/lowering/shared"
```

Package shared contains common lowering operations and typed values.

Value keeps checked types and source identities with generated expressions. Result keeps statements with their values until a caller builds Go syntax. This package does not import lowering rules.

## type Result

Result keeps evaluation statements with the values they produce.

```go
type Result struct {
    Statements []ast.Stmt
    Values     []Value
}
```

### func \(Result\) Expressions

```go
func (result Result) Expressions() []ast.Expr
```

Expressions returns the Go nodes for statement construction.

## type Value

Value keeps a Go expression with its checked type and source identity. A tuple type means that the expression supplies multiple results.

```go
type Value struct {
    Expression ast.Expr
    Type       types.Type
    Original   ast.Expr
    Temporary  bool
}
```
